# Zoom renewal and cancellation guide

**Which terms apply depends on how you bought Zoom.** The self-serve Terms of Service, an enterprise MSA and an order form can each set different rules. I could not retrieve a current dated version of the official terms. The copy of the Terms of Service I found on zoom.com was indexed as roughly 1,188 days old. A third-party check dated 13 Nov 2026 matches its 30-day figure (see below). Confirm against the live terms.

## Default renewal behaviour (online Terms of Service)
- **Auto-renewal is the default.** 
Unless your Order Form says otherwise or applicable law prohibits automatic renewal, each Renewal Term begins automatically at the end of the current term.

- **Notice window is 30 calendar days.** Written notice of termination or modification must be given 
at least thirty (30) calendar days before the next Renewal Term starts, or within the notice period required by applicable law
. A 
13 November 2026 comparison of vendors' terms also lists Zoom at 30 calendar days
.
- **Pricing.** 
Promotional or discounted prices may expire when a Renewal Term begins.
 The same comparison lists 
a 30-day notice period for price changes at Zoom
. I did not verify that against Zoom's own text, so treat it as unconfirmed.
- **Payments.** 
Payments are non-cancelable for the current term and non-refundable, unless Zoom agrees otherwise, the law requires it, or your order form says so.


## How to give notice
1. **Self-serve accounts:** The terms say to 
notify Zoom via the billing portal (if available for your account) or by email to renewals@zoom.us, within the Renewal Notice Period
.
2. **Web portal route:**
   - Navigation labels have changed over time. One source says 
go to Plans and Billing, then Plan Management
.
   - Older Zoom Community answers use 
Account Management > Billing > Current Plans > Cancel Subscription
.
   - Zoom's own help-center article was not retrieved. Treat the exact menu names as unverified.
3. **If the portal says "Contact Sales":** A Zoom Community answer says 
you must contact the sales team or your Account Executive to cancel
. A third-party guide says 
sales-quote purchases are cancelled by emailing your Account Executive or renewals@zoom.us
.
4. **App Store or Google Play purchases:** One third-party guide says 
these must be cancelled through those platforms
.
5. **Keep proof of the date and method of notice.** The Terms of Service require written notice.

## Key caveats
- **Access after cancelling:** Cancelling stops renewal, but 
you keep your paid plan for the rest of the subscription term
.
- **Conflicting guidance on timing:**
  - A Zoom Community reply quoting the online cart says 
you may request cancellation up until the day before auto-renewal
.
  - The Terms of Service say 30 days.
  - For annual or order-form plans, assume 30 days. Which rule applies to your plan is not verified.
- **Refunds:**
  - A Zoom Community answer says a refund may be possible 
if requested within 30 days of renewal, and only prorated
. This is an older post and eligibility conditions are unclear.
